settings.title: Use a ring that fits
settings.text: Measure the inside diameter of a ring that fits the finger you want, in millimetres, and find it in the table.

settings.title: Or measure your finger
settings.text: Wrap a strip of paper around the base of your finger, mark where it overlaps and measure it: that's the circumference.

settings.title: Between two sizes?
settings.text: Choose the larger one. Fingers are a little bigger at the end of the day and in warm weather.

settings.name: Choker
settings.description: Sits close to the base of the neck. Most Rommanel chokers are around this length.

settings.name: Short
settings.description: Rests just above the collarbone, lovely with small pendants.

settings.name: Princess
settings.description: Falls on the collarbone. The most popular length.

settings.name: Matinee
settings.description: Just below the collarbone. Many Rommanel necklaces are 50 cm and adjust to 45 cm.

settings.name: Long
settings.description: Sits at the top of the bust, perfect for layering.

settings.heading: Find your perfect fit
settings.text: Our rings use Australian sizes. If you know your Brazilian size (aro), you'll find it in the table too.
